> v8.0.0-rc.19 @default now means a database default, and values the client generates are written @onCreate(...) and @onUpdate(...) . Every default is stored in one form owned by its column's data type, so date, time and bytes defaults are written with tags. Clients take the contract as a typed value, can render any plan as SQL without a database, and run each ORM call as one activity that middleware and the cache can see.
